results.title: Video Essay: Digital Puppetry
results.brief_description:
Digital puppetry uses pixels as the puppet’s body. Instead of strings, rods or hands inside the puppet, movement can be captured through motion-capture suits, facial cameras, sensors and tracking markers. Animators then work with digital rigs to shape the final character on screen.

The tools have changed, but the relationship is familiar. Someone still guides another body, helping it move, react and seem alive.
